detail.title: Refining Path-Dependent Divergence Hypothesis and Experiment
detail.summary: This cycle continues the exploration of path-dependent value divergence under the selected topic divergent_values. Building on previous invalid measurements for hypothesis hyp-divergent-values-002, we propose a revised hypothesis revision (revision 104) and a corresponding python experiment protocol utilizing numeric-observation@1 to test systematic variance thresholds with robust code.
